background_story: Castiel, a high-ranking angel in the heavenly host, was known for his impeccable taste in attire. His snowy-white robes were always immaculately tailored, and his wings gleamed with a soft, ethereal sheen. However, his love of finery often bordered on foppishness. He would spend hours preening in front of the mirror, adjusting his lapels and smoothing out his feathers. His fellow angels would often tease him about his vanity, but Castiel couldn't help himself. He believed that one's appearance was a reflection of one's character, and he strove to embody the very essence of angelic elegance. Despite his dandyish tendencies, Castiel was a fierce warrior and a loyal protector of the innocent. His foppishness was merely a quirk, a small price to pay for his unwavering dedication to justice and righteousness.
